description: This file defines a TypeScript class 'LLMClient' for interacting with a language model API, including methods for sending prompts and handling streaming responses, along with related interfaces and utility functions.

classes.name: LLMClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Kilocode's language model API, supporting prompt completion and streaming FIM responses.

methods.name: getKiloBaseUriFromToken
methods.description: Extracts the base URL for Kilocode API from a token, defaulting to production URL if not in development environment.

methods.name: isFimMode
methods.description: Returns whether the client is operating in FIM mode.

methods.name: sendPrompt
methods.description: Sends a chat prompt to the language model API and returns the response.

methods.name: sendFimCompletion
methods.description: Requests a streaming FIM completion from the API, handling SSE stream and returning the accumulated result.
